    Lowered the jump speed a little bit

notes.title: V 1.0.4 Update
notes.content:
In this update I made a few changes to make the playability of the game a little bit better.

Changes:

    Made the restart times between deaths shorter
    Now death messages only show up once per play session
    If there isn't a new death message then the game will automatically spawn a new player
    Removed fade in/out between death restarts
    Changed a few areas in level 1, and 2
    Lowered the amount of inertia when the player is jumping in the air
    Decreased the fall speed of the player a little bit
